topic.label: Mobile App Development
topic.desc: Building, packaging and shipping apps for Android and iOS phones and tablets.

concepts: Native and web-wrapped Android apps: Kotlin, WebView, Gradle builds and Play Store release.
Turning a web or HTML app into an installable mobile app with a WebView shell or a progressive web app.
skills: Wraps an existing web app (such as an MCP App) in an Android WebView shell and builds a signed APK.
Signs, versions and uploads an Android app bundle to the Play Store.
Adds a manifest and service worker so a web app installs on Android as a progressive web app.
Packages a web app with Capacitor into native Android and iOS projects.

provenance.notes: test fixture for the Fill the gap test (test_ui.cjs 1u)
